title: Counting Freeze Days on a Self-Pay Visit Package: Paused Series and Visits During a Freeze
content:
**Scheduling desk rule.** The freeze days of a Self-Pay Visit Package are counted differently in two situations.

1. Where the Appointment Series the package funds was paused on or before the freeze start date and no package visit has been used on or after the freeze start date, both the freeze start date and the unfreeze date are counted — the difference between the two dates, increased by one.
2. Where a package visit has been used on or after the freeze start date, the freeze days run only from the freeze start date to the date of the latest package visit used — the difference between those two dates.

In any other case neither of these counts applies.

**Records read**

- *Paused on or before the freeze start date:* the pause start date on the Appointment Series linked to the package is the freeze start date or earlier.
- *A package visit used:* an attended appointment paid from the package, as the package history records it with its appointment date; the latest such appointment date is the date of the latest package visit used.
- *Freeze start date:* as recorded on the package.

**Branch table**

| Series pause start date on or before the freeze start date | Package visit used on or after the freeze start date | Count |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | both the freeze start date and the unfreeze date counted |
| Yes | Yes | freeze start date to the latest package visit used |
| No, or no pause on record | Yes | freeze start date to the latest package visit used |
| No, or no pause on record | No | neither count applies |

**Date cases (hypothetical: freeze start 1 March, unfreeze 21 March)**

- Series paused from 25 February, no package visit since 1 March: 1 March to 21 March, both ends counted — 21 days.
- Series paused from 1 March itself, no package visit since: both ends counted — 21 days.
- A package visit used on 10 March, whatever the series shows: 1 March to 10 March — 9 days.
- A package visit used on 1 March itself: 0 days.
- Series paused from 5 March, no package visit since 1 March: neither count applies.
